mentions.name: MacVisor
mentions.description: A versatile virtualizer for running macOS and Linux VMs on Apple Silicon. Usable as a desktop virtualizer, as a local virtualization host (a hypervisor app like Proxmox or libvirt/virsh, but for Mac), or as a CLI-driven infrastructure tool.
